plugin.name: InventoryWindow
plugin.author: Crowley
plugin.purpose: Inventory, worn gear and bags in one window

trigger.match: ^You will now see object and mob flags(.*)$

muclient.script:
-- InventoryWindow.lua : one window for inventory, worn gear and bags (module loaded by InventoryWindow.xml) -- -- Reads the game's own tagged lists: invdata (carried items), eqdata (worn items) and -- "invdata <bag>" (a bag's contents). Each line is -- objectid,flags,name,level,type,unique,wearloc,timer -- After the first load the {invmon} tags keep it current without more commands: gear moves between -- the lists locally, and only a brand-new item makes it ask for the list again. -- Written for MUSHclient's Lua 5.1: no 5.2+ features.
require "gmcphelper" require "themed_miniwindows" pcall(dofile, GetInfo(60) .. "telnet_options.lua")
local WIN = "InventoryWin" local FONT, FONT_B = "if", "ifb" local PAD, GAP, SB_W = 8, 8, 9
local fontName = GetAlphaOption("output_font_name") local fontHeight = GetOption("output_font_height") local lh = 14
local InfoWin, shown = nil, false local added = {}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Helpers --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local function rgb(r, g, b) return r + g * 256 + b * 65536 end local function lerp(a, b, t) return a + (b - a) * t end local function split(c) return c % 256, math.floor(c / 256) % 256, math.floor(c / 65536) % 256 end
local function mixC(c1, c2, t) local r1, g1, b1 = split(c1) local r2, g2, b2 = split(c2) return rgb(math.floor(lerp(r1, r2, t)), math.floor(lerp(g1, g2, t)), math.floor(lerp(b1, b2, t))) end
local function trim(s) return (s:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")) end
local function commas(n) n = tonumber(n) or 0 local s = tostring(math.floor(math.abs(n))) s = s:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1,"):reverse() s = s:gsub("^,", "") return (n < 0 and "-" or "") .. s end
local ACC = { blue = rgb(90, 150, 240), teal = rgb(70, 200, 200), amber = rgb(235, 185, 70), orange = rgb(235, 125, 70), green = rgb(90, 200, 115), gold = rgb(240, 200, 80), grey = rgb(130, 130, 145), cyan = rgb(110, 190, 255), red = rgb(235, 90, 80), purple = rgb(170, 125, 235), pink = rgb(230, 120, 190), }
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Aardwolf colour codes in item names: @r @g @y @b @m @c @w @D (dark) @R @G @Y @B @M @C @W (bright), -- @x### (xterm 256 colours) and @@ for a real @ --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local CODE = { r = rgb(170, 0, 0), g = rgb(0, 170, 0), y = rgb(170, 170, 0), b = rgb(60, 80, 220), m = rgb(170, 0, 170), c = rgb(0, 170, 170), w = rgb(192, 192, 192), D = rgb(128, 128, 128), R = rgb(255, 60, 60), G = rgb(60, 255, 60), Y = rgb(255, 255, 60), B = rgb(90, 110, 255), M = rgb(255, 60, 255), C = rgb(60, 255, 255), W = rgb(255, 255, 255), } local CUBE = { 0, 95, 135, 175, 215, 255 } local XTERM16 = { [0] = rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(170, 0, 0), rgb(0, 170, 0), rgb(170, 170, 0), rgb(60, 80, 220), rgb(170, 0, 170), rgb(0, 170, 170), rgb(192, 192, 192), rgb(128, 128, 128), rgb(255, 60, 60), rgb(60, 255, 60), rgb(255, 255, 60), rgb(90, 110, 255), rgb(255, 60, 255), rgb(60, 255, 255), rgb(255, 255, 255), }
local function xterm(n) if n < 16 then return XTERM16[n] end if n < 232 then n = n - 16 return rgb(CUBE[math.floor(n / 36) + 1], CUBE[math.floor(n / 6) % 6 + 1], CUBE[n % 6 + 1]) end local v = 8 + (n - 232) * 10 return rgb(v, v, v) end
local colourCache, colourCount = {}, 0
-- returns the plain text and a list of runs { text, col } (col nil = no colour given) local function parseColours(s) s = tostring(s or "") local hit = colourCache[s] if hit then return hit[1], hit[2] end local runs, buf, col = {}, {}, nil local function flush() if #buf > 0 then runs[#runs + 1] = { text = table.concat(buf), col = col } buf = {} end end local i, n = 1, #s while i <= n do local ch = s:sub(i, i) local nx = (ch == "@") and s:sub(i + 1, i + 1) or "" if nx == "@" then buf[#buf + 1] = "@" i = i + 2 elseif nx == "x" and s:match("^%d%d?%d?", i + 2) and tonumber(s:match("^%d%d?%d?", i + 2)) <= 255 then local digits = s:match("^%d%d?%d?", i + 2) flush() col = xterm(tonumber(digits)) i = i + 2 + #digits elseif nx ~= "" and CODE[nx] then flush() col = CODE[nx] i = i + 2 else buf[#buf + 1] = ch i = i + 1 end end flush() local plain = {} for _, r in ipairs(runs) do plain[#plain + 1] = r.text end local p = table.concat(plain) colourCount = colourCount + 1 if colourCount > 6000 then colourCache, colourCount = {}, 0 end colourCache[s] = { p, runs } return p, runs end
local function lum(c) local r, g, b = split(c) return 0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b end
-- keep very dark game colours readable on a dark window (and very light ones on a light window) local function legible(c, P) local bgl = lum(P.bg) if bgl < 128 and lum(c) < 70 then return mixC(c, P.text, 0.55) end if bgl >= 128 and lum(c) > 200 then return mixC(c, P.text, 0.55) end return c end
local function palette() local bg, tx = Theme.PRIMARY_BODY, Theme.BODY_TEXT return { bg = bg, text = tx, muted = mixC(tx, bg, 0.45), panel = mixC(bg, tx, 0.07), edge = mixC(bg, tx, 0.24), track = mixC(bg, tx, 0.17), } end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- What the numbers in the tags mean --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local TYPE_NAME = { [0] = "None", "Light", "Scroll", "Wand", "Staff", "Weapon", "Treasure", "Armor", "Potion", "Furniture", "Trash", "Container", "Drink", "Key", "Food", "Boat", "Mob corpse", "Player corpse", "Fountain", "Pill", "Portal", "Beacon", "Gift card", "Unused", "Raw material", "Campfire", "Forge", "Runestone", }
local WEAR_NAME = { [0] = "Light", "Head", "Eyes", "Left ear", "Right ear", "Neck 1", "Neck 2", "Back", "Medal 1", "Medal 2", "Medal 3", "Medal 4", "Torso", "Body", "Waist", "Arms", "Left wrist", "Right wrist", "Hands", "Left finger", "Right finger", "Legs", "Feet", "Shield", "Wielded", "Second", "Held", "Floating", "Tattoo 1", "Tattoo 2", "Above", "Portal", "Sleeping", } local WEAR_MAX = 32
-- groups for the chips under the tabs local GROUPS = { "any", "gear", "use", "bags", "loot", "portal", "other" } local GROUP_NAMES = { any = "All", gear = "Gear", use = "Consumables", bags = "Containers", loot = "Loot", portal = "Portals", other = "Other" } local TYPE_GROUP = { [1] = "gear", [5] = "gear", [7] = "gear", [26] = "gear", [2] = "use", [3] = "use", [4] = "use", [8] = "use", [12] = "use", [14] = "use", [19] = "use", [11] = "bags", [6] = "loot", [10] = "loot", [22] = "loot", [24] = "loot", [20] = "portal", [21] = "portal", } local TYPE_COLOUR = { gear = ACC.orange, use = ACC.green, bags = ACC.gold, loot = ACC.amber, portal = ACC.cyan, other = ACC.grey, } local FLAG_COLOUR = { K = ACC.red, M = ACC.blue, G = ACC.gold, H = ACC.cyan, I = ACC.grey, C = ACC.amber, T = ACC.orange, E = ACC.green, W = ACC.pink, N = ACC.purple }
local itemRow -- (defined further down, once dinv's data exists) local identifyBlocked, setIdentifyMethod -- (the identify settings, defined with the identify card)
-- Armor, weapons and lights are always gear. Anything else is gear too when dinv says it is worn in a -- slot other than "held" (a ring typed as Treasure, a floating item, ...). local function groupOf(it) local g = TYPE_GROUP[it.type] or "other" if g == "gear" then return g end local r = itemRow and itemRow(it.id and it or { id = it.ids and it.ids[1] }) local w = r and r.wearable and tostring(r.wearable):lower() or "" if w ~= "" and not w:find("^hold") then return "gear" end if g == "other" or g == "loot" or g == "use" then if it.wear and it.wear >= 0 and it.wear ~= 26 and it.wear ~= 31 and w == "" then return "gear" end end return g end
-- the second row of chips under Gear: where the item is worn local SLOTS = { "any", "head", "eyes", "ear", "neck", "back", "body", "arms", "hands", "wrist", "finger", "waist", "legs", "feet", "wield", "shield", "hold", "light", "float", "medal", "above" } local SLOT_NAMES = { any = "Any slot", head = "Head", eyes = "Eyes", ear = "Ears", neck = "Neck", back = "Back", body = "Body", arms = "Arms", hands = "Hands", wrist = "Wrists", finger = "Fingers", waist = "Waist", legs = "Legs", feet = "Feet", wield = "Weapon", shield = "Shield", hold = "Held", light = "Light", float = "Floating", medal = "Medals", above = "Above" } -- the game's slot numbers -> a slot chip local NUM_SLOT = { [0] = "light", "head", "eyes", "ear", "ear", "neck", "neck", "back", "medal", "medal", "medal", "medal", "body", "body", "waist", "arms", "wrist", "wrist", "hands", "finger", "finger", "legs", "feet", "shield", "wield", "wield", "hold", "float", nil, nil, "above" }
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- State --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local inv = {} -- [id] = item, carried (not worn) local worn = {} -- [wearloc] = item local bags = {} -- [bagId] = { items = {[id] = item}, count, fetchedAt } local loaded = { inv = false, eq = false } local fetchedAt = nil local pending = {} -- what we have asked the game for, with the time local mode -- what the lines being read right now belong to: { kind = "inv" | "eq" | "bag", bag = id } local readInv, readEq, readBag
local readKey, keyringSource = {}, nil -- the keyring as the game listed it ("keyring data"), when dinv is not there to tell us local wornSource = nil -- "dinv" or "game": where the Worn tab's list came from local keyring = {} -- items on the keyring (only dinv knows these) local dinv = { items = {}, loadedAt = nil, err = nil } -- dinv's database, read-only: [obj id] = row
local TABS = { "inv", "worn", "bags", "keyring", "all" } local TAB_NAMES = { inv = "Inventory", worn = "Worn", bags = "Bags", keyring = "Keyring", all = "Everywhere" } local SORTS = { "level", "name", "type" } local SORT_NAMES = { level = "Level", name = "Name", type = "Type" }
local function oneOf(list, v, default) for _, x in ipairs(list) do if x == v then return v end end return default end
local view = { tab = oneOf(TABS, GetVariable("tab"), "inv"), group = oneOf(GROUPS, GetVariable("group"), "any"), sort = oneOf(SORTS, GetVariable("sort"), "level"), empty = GetVariable("empty") ~= "0", slot = oneOf(SLOTS, GetVariable("slot"), "any"), filter = "", q = nil, bag = nil, scroll = 0, bagOpen = {}, -- bag groups (same name) that are listed individually open = {}, -- stacks that are expanded into their individual items }
local function saveView() SetVariable("tab", view.tab) SetVariable("group", view.group) SetVariable("slot", view.slot) SetVariable("sort", view.sort) SetVariable("empty", view.empty and "1" or "0") end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Reading the game's lines --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local placeCounter = 0
local function newItem(wc) local plain, runs = parseColours(wc.name) placeCounter = placeCounter + 1 return { id = tonumber(wc.id), flags = wc.flags or "", name = plain, runs = runs, lname = plain:lower(), level = tonumber(wc.level) or 0, type = tonumber(wc.type) or 0, unique = tonumber(wc.unique) == 1, wear = tonumber(wc.wear) or -1, timer = tonumber(wc.timer) or -1, place = placeCounter, } end
local function sendQuiet(cmd) -- the same way wrapped_captures does it: no paging prompt in the middle of a list if TELOPT_PAGING then pcall(TelnetOptionOff, TELOPT_PAGING) end SendNoEcho(cmd) if TELOPT_PAGING then pcall(TelnetOptionOn, TELOPT_PAGING) end end
-- Fiendish: a window must ask for a buffered repaint whenever it changes, or it only shows up on the next repaint. -- Aardwolf package snapshot (r2378 and so on) from aard_lua_extras; nil when it cannot be told. -- r2160 first shipped wrapped_captures; r2359 and later have BufferedRepaint() built into MUSHclient, -- older ones go through the repaint plugin. IW_MIN_WRAPPED, IW_MIN_REPAINT = 2160, 2359 local IW_snap function IW_snapshot() if IW_snap == nil then local ok, extras = pcall(require, "aard_lua_extras") local ok2, v = false, nil if ok and type(extras) == "table" and extras.PackageVersion then ok2, v = pcall(extras.PackageVersion) end IW_snap = (ok2 and tonumber(v)) or false end return IW_snap or nil end function IW_repaint() local snap = IW_snapshot() if BufferedRepaint and (not snap or snap >= IW_MIN_REPAINT) then BufferedRepaint() elseif IsPluginInstalled("abc1a0944ae4af7586ce88dc") then CallPlugin("abc1a0944ae4af7586ce88dc", "BufferedRepaint") else Redraw() end end function IW_needWrapped() -- message for a missing wrapped_captures module local snap = IW_snapshot() return "needs wrapped_captures, which came with Aardwolf package r2160 or newer" .. (snap and (" (yours is r" .. snap .. ")") or "") .. ". Please update the package." end
local redrawPending = nil function IW_doRedraw() redrawPending = nil if shown then safeDraw() end end
local function requestRedraw() if shown and (not redrawPending or os.clock() - redrawPending > 2) then redrawPending = os.clock() DoAfterSpecial(0.15, "IW_doRedraw()", sendto.script) end end
-- A list we asked for ourselves is kept away from everything else (your world's own "You are using:" -- formatter would otherwise print the whole equipment list every time the window refreshes). Lists that -- you or another plugin asked for pass through untouched. local mineBlock = false local function claimed(key) local t = pending[key] return t ~= nil and os.time() - t < 12 end
-- the game's own setting: are flags shown in full, (Keep)(Magic), or as letters, (K)(M)? local gameFlagsFull = GetVariable("gameflagsfull") == "1" local FLAG_FULL = { K = "Keep", M = "Magic", G = "Glowing", H = "Humming", N = "Nolocate", I = "Invis", T = "Tempered", C = "Cursed", E = "Envenomed", W = "Weakened" } -- the game's own flag-hiding options (name, letter, what it hides); the order is the game's local FLAG_OPTIONS = { { "Kept", "K", "kept items" }, { "Invis", "I", "invisible items" }, { "Magic", "M", "magical items" }, { "Glow", "G", "glowing items" }, { "Hum", "H", "humming items" }, { "Tempered", "T", "tempered items" }, { "Cursed", "C", "cursed items" }, { "Envenomed", "E", "envenomed weapons" }, { "Weakened", "W", "weakened items" }, { "Nolocate", "N", "nolocate items" }, } function IW_flagMsg(name, line, wc) gameFlagsFull = (wc[1] or ""):lower():find("full", 1, true) ~= nil SetVariable("gameflagsfull", gameFlagsFull and "1" or "0") end function IW_flagSeen() if not gameFlagsFull then gameFlagsFull = true SetVariable("gameflagsfull", "1") end end local hiddenFlags = {} -- flag letters left out of the [KMGH] form (invwin objflag) for ch in (GetVariable("hiddenflags") or ""):gmatch("%a") do hiddenFlags[ch] = true end local function visibleFlags(flags, short) if not short then return flags end return (flags:gsub("%a", function(ch) return hiddenFlags[ch] and "" or nil end)) end local showPlus = GetVariable("showplus") == "1" -- show a + when flags were hidden from an item local takeI = GetVariable("takei") == "1" -- off by default: "i" belongs to the game (or the serials plugin); invwin print on to print here local serialsOn = GetVariable("serials") == "1" -- item serial numbers after each name in the printed list local serialsOnce = false -- "i serials": just this once local SERIALS_ID = "0cbb10309587f0ee15ba78ce" -- the Aardwolf package's aard_inventory_serials plugin local function serialsPluginOn() return IsPluginInstalled(SERIALS_ID) and GetPluginInfo(SERIALS_ID, 17) and true or false end local function wantSerials() if serialsOn or serialsOnce then return true end -- the serials plugin's own "always show serial numbers" setting counts too return serialsPluginOn() and tostring(GetPluginVariable(SERIALS_ID, "visible_always")) == "1" end pcall(EnableAlias, "IW_i", takeI) local shortFlags = GetVariable("shortflags") == "1" -- off by default: (K)(M)(G)(H); on: [KMGH] local printInventory -- defined below; shows the carried list as text when you type i
function IW_invStart(name, line, wc) local bag = tonumber(wc[1]) mode = bag and { kind = "bag", bag = bag } or { kind = "inv" } readInv, readBag, placeCounter = {}, {}, 0 mineBlock = claimed(bag and ("bag" .. bag) or "inv") EnableTriggerGroup("IWitems", true) if mineBlock then StopEvaluatingTriggers(true) end end
function IW_eqStart(name, line, wc) mode = { kind = "eq" } readEq, placeCounter = {}, 0 mineBlock = claimed("eq") EnableTriggerGroup("IWitems", true) if mineBlock then StopEvaluatingTriggers(true) end end
function IW_keyStart(name, line, wc) mode = { kind = "key" } readKey, placeCounter = {}, 0 mineBlock = claimed("key") EnableTriggerGroup("IWitems", true) if mineBlock then StopEvaluatingTriggers(true) end end
function IW_itemLine(name, line, wc) if mineBlock then StopEvaluatingTriggers(true) end if not mode then return end local it = newItem(wc) if not it.id then return end if mode.kind == "inv" then readInv[it.id] = it elseif mode.kind == "bag" then readBag[it.id] = it elseif mode.kind == "eq" then if it.wear >= 0 then readEq[it.wear] = it end elseif mode.kind == "key" then it.loc = -2 readKey[#readKey + 1] = it end end
local printAfter = false
function IW_listEnd(name, line, wc) local wasMine = mineBlock mineBlock = false EnableTriggerGroup("IWitems", false) if mode then local now = os.time() local kind = mode.kind if kind == "inv" then inv, loaded.inv, pending.inv = readInv, true, nil -- bags that left the inventory are gone for id in pairs(bags) do if not inv[id] then bags[id] = nil end end elseif kind == "eq" then worn, loaded.eq, pending.eq, wornSource = readEq, true, nil, "game" elseif kind == "key" then keyring, keyringSource, pending.key = readKey, "game", nil elseif kind == "bag" then local n = 0 for _ in pairs(readBag) do n = n + 1 end bags[mode.bag] = { items = readBag, count = n, fetchedAt = now, source = "game" } pending["bag" .. mode.bag] = nil end fetchedAt = now mode = nil requestRedraw() if kind == "inv" and printAfter then printAfter = false printInventory() end end if wasMine then StopEvaluatingTriggers(true) end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- dinv's database (read-only): bag contents and the keyring without asking the game --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local DINV_PLUGIN = "731f94b0f2b54345f836bbaf"
local TYPE_BY_NAME = {} for n, name in pairs(TYPE_NAME) do TYPE_BY_NAME[(name:lower():gsub("%s", ""))] = n end
local function dinvPath() local who = gmcp("char.base.name") if type(who) ~= "string" or who == "" then return nil end return GetInfo(60) .. "state\\dinv-" .. DINV_PLUGIN .. "\\" .. who .. "\\dinv.db" end
-- dinv keeps the long identify flags; the game's short letters are the closest match local function flagLetters(text) local f = "," .. (text or ""):lower():gsub("%s", "") .. "," local out = "" if f:find(",glow,", 1, true) then out = out .. "G" end if f:find(",hum,", 1, true) then out = out .. "H" end if f:find(",magic,", 1, true) then out = out .. "M" end if f:find(",invis,", 1, true) then out = out .. "I" end return out end
-- dinv's own wear-slot names -> the game's slot numbers local DINV_WEAR = { light = 0, head = 1, eyes = 2, lear = 3, rear = 4, neck1 = 5, neck2 = 6, back = 7, medal1 = 8, medal2 = 9, medal3 = 10, medal4 = 11, torso = 12, body = 13, waist = 14, arms = 15, lwrist = 16, rwrist = 17, hands = 18, lfinger = 19, rfinger = 20, legs = 21, feet = 22, shield = 23, wielded = 24, second = 25, hold = 26, float = 27, tattoo1 = 28, tattoo2 = 29, above = 30, portal = 31, sleeping = 32 }
local function dinvItem(id, r) -- color_name keeps the item's own colours local coded = (r.color_name and r.color_name ~= "") and tostring(r.color_name) or ((r.name and r.name ~= "") and tostring(r.name) or "(not identified yet)") local name, runs = parseColours(coded) return { id = id, flags = flagLetters(r.flags), name = name, runs = runs, lname = name:lower(), level = tonumber(r.level) or 0, type = TYPE_BY_NAME[(tostring(r.type or ""):lower():gsub("%s", ""))] or 0, unique = false, wear = -1, timer = -1, fromDinv = true, } end
local function dinvApply() local newBags, kr = {}, {} for id, r in pairs(dinv.items) do local where = tostring(r.object_location or "") if where == "keyring" then local it = dinvItem(id, r) it.loc = -2 kr[#kr + 1] = it else local c = tonumber(where) if c and c == tonumber(r.home_container) then local b = newBags[c] if not b then b = { items = {}, count = 0, fetchedAt = dinv.loadedAt, source = "dinv" } newBags[c] = b end b.items[id] = dinvItem(id, r) b.count = b.count + 1 end end end if keyringSource ~= "game" then keyring = kr end -- a list we just read from the game wins for c, b in pairs(newBags) do local old = bags[c] if not (old and old.source == "game") then bags[c] = b end -- what the game just told us wins end
-- what you are wearing: dinv knows it too, so the Worn tab needs no command (and your world's own -- "You are using:" formatter is not set off by one). Only an explicit "Read from the game" asks. if wornSource ~= "game" then local dw = {} for id, r in pairs(dinv.items) do local slot = DINV_WEAR[tostring(r.object_location or "")] if slot then local it = dinvItem(id, r) it.wear = slot dw[slot] = it end end worn, wornSource, loaded.eq = dw, "dinv", true end end
-- returns true when the database was read local function dinvRead() local path = dinvPath() if not path then dinv.err = "waiting for your character name" return false end local fh = io.open(path, "rb") if not fh then dinv.err = "dinv's database was not found" return false end fh:close() local ok, db = pcall(sqlite3.open, path) if not ok or not db then dinv.err = "could not open dinv's database" return false end local okQ, items = pcall(function() local stmt = db:prepare("SELECT * FROM items") if not stmt then error("busy") end local out = {} while stmt:step() == sqlite3.ROW do local r = stmt:get_named_values() local id = tonumber(r.obj_id) if id then out[id] = r end end stmt:finalize() return out end) pcall(function() db:close() end) if not okQ then dinv.err = "dinv's database is busy; try Refresh in a moment" return false end dinv.items, dinv.loadedAt, dinv.err = items, os.time(), nil dinvApply() return true end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Asking the game --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local function ask(key, cmd) local t = pending[key] if t and os.time() - t < 8 then return end pending[key] = os.time() sendQuiet(cmd) end
local function askInv() ask("inv", "invdata") end local function askEq() ask("eq", "eqdata") end local function askBag(id) ask("bag" .. id, "invdata " .. id) end local function askKeyring() ask("key", "keyring data") end
local refreshQueued = false function IW_doRefresh() refreshQueued = false askInv() end
-- many tags can arrive at once (a loot burst); ask for the carried list just once afterwards local function queueInvRefresh() if not refreshQueued then refreshQueued = true DoAfterSpecial(1.5, "IW_doRefresh()", sendto.script) end end
local function loadAllBags() local n = 0 for id, it in pairs(inv) do if it.type == 11 then n = n + 1 DoAfterSpecial(0.6 * n, "IW_askBag(" .. id .. ")", sendto.script) end end end
function IW_askBag(id) askBag(tonumber(id)) end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Live changes from {invmon}action,objectid,container,wearloc --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local function findInBags(id) for bagId, b in pairs(bags) do if b.items[id] then return bagId, b.items[id] end end end
-- something unknown was worn or removed: re-read dinv a moment later (it handles the same tag), or ask the -- game if dinv is not available function IW_rereadDinv() dinvRead() requestRedraw() end
local function wornChanged() if wornSource == "game" or dinv.err then askEq() else DoAfterSpecial(2.5, "IW_rereadDinv()", sendto.script) end end
function IW_invmon(name, line, wc) local action, id, container, wear = tonumber(wc[1]), tonumber(wc[2]), tonumber(wc[3]), tonumber(wc[4]) if not (action and id) then return end
if action == 1 then -- removed: worn -> carried local it = worn[wear] if it and it.id == id then worn[wear] = nil it.wear = -1 inv[id] = it else queueInvRefresh() wornChanged() end elseif action == 2 then -- worn: carried -> worn local it = inv[id] if it then inv[id] = nil it.wear = wear worn[wear] = it else wornChanged() queueInvRefresh() end elseif action == 3 or action == 7 or action == 9 or action == 11 then -- dropped, sold, eaten, vaulted, keyringed inv[id] = nil if bags[id] then bags[id] = nil end elseif action == 4 or action == 10 or action == 12 then -- picked up, out of vault or keyring queueInvRefresh() elseif action == 5 then -- taken out of a bag local b = bags[container] if b and b.items[id] then local it = b.items[id] b.items[id] = nil b.count = math.max(0, (b.count or 1) - 1) it.wear = -1 inv[id] = it else queueInvRefresh() end elseif action == 6 then -- put into a bag local it = inv[id] inv[id] = nil local b = bags[container] if b and it then b.items[id] = it b.count = (b.count or 0) + 1 elseif b then askBag(container) end end requestRedraw() end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Building the lists to show --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- identical items (same name, level, flags) collapse into one stack with a count local function stackItems(list) local stacks, byKey = {}, {} for _, it in ipairs(list) do local key = it.lname .. "|" .. it.level .. "|" .. it.flags .. "|" .. it.type .. "|" .. tostring(it.loc) local s = byKey[key] if s then s.count = s.count + 1 s.ids[#s.ids + 1] = it.id if (it.place or 0) < s.place then s.place = it.place end else s = { name = it.name, runs = it.runs, lname = it.lname, level = it.level, flags = it.flags, type = it.type, unique = it.unique, timer = it.timer, loc = it.loc, count = 1, ids = { it.id }, place = it.place or 0, key = key } byKey[key] = s stacks[#stacks + 1] = s end end return stacks end
local function bagList() local out = {} for id, it in pairs(inv) do if it.type == 11 then out[#out + 1] = it end end table.sort(out, function(a, b) if (a.place or 0) ~= (b.place or 0) then return (a.place or 0) < (b.place or 0) end return a.id < b.id end) -- number identical names (in the order the game listed them) (#1, #2, ...) so six "Bag of Aardwolf" can be told apart local seen, total = {}, {} for _, b in ipairs(out) do total[b.lname] = (total[b.lname] or 0) + 1 end for _, b in ipairs(out) do seen[b.lname] = (seen[b.lname] or 0) + 1 local base = b.name:gsub("^[Aa]n? ", ""):gsub("^[Tt]he ", "") b.label = (total[b.lname] > 1) and (base .. " #" .. seen[b.lname]) or base end return out end
local function bagLabel(id) for _, b in ipairs(bagList()) do if b.id == id then return b.label end end return "bag " .. id end
-- where an item is worn: the slot it sits in, or what dinv knows it fits itemRow = function(it) return dinv.items[it.id] or dinv.items[tostring(it.id)] or dinv.items[tonumber(it.id) or -1] end
local function slotOf(it) if it.wear and it.wear >= 0 and NUM_SLOT[it.wear] then return NUM_SLOT[it.wear] end local r = itemRow(it) local w = r and r.wearable and tostring(r.wearable):lower() or "" if w == "" then return nil end return w:match("^(%a+)") end
-- Targeted searches: invwin spells:lotus type:potion lvl:1-10 wear:arms flag:magic in:worn "some words" local QKEY = { type = "type", t = "type", wear = "wear", slot = "wear", w = "wear", spell = "spell", spells = "spell", s = "spell", lvl = "lvl", level = "lvl", l = "lvl", flag = "flag", flags = "flag", f = "flag", ["in"] = "in", loc = "in", where = "in", name = "name", n = "name" } local SLOT_ALIAS = { ears = "ear", wrists = "wrist", fingers = "finger", weapon = "wield", wielded = "wield", held = "hold", medals = "medal", torso = "body", chest = "body", leg = "legs", foot = "feet", hand = "hands", arm = "arms", shields = "shield", floating = "float" } local FLAG_LETTER = { glow = "G", hum = "H", magic = "M", invis = "I", invisible = "I" }
local function typeMatches(word) word = word:gsub("%s", "") local out, any = {}, false for n, name in pairs(TYPE_NAME) do local ln = (name:lower():gsub("%s", "")) if ln == word or (#word >= 3 and ln:sub(1, #word) == word) then out[n] = true any = true end end return any and out or nil end
local function splitWords(rest) local tokens, i = {}, 1 while i <= #rest do if rest:sub(i, i):match("%s") then i = i + 1 else local j, buf = i, "" while j <= #rest and not rest:sub(j, j):match("%s") do local ch = rest:sub(j, j) if ch == '"' then local close = rest:find('"', j + 1, true) or (#rest + 1) buf = buf .. rest:sub(j + 1, close - 1) j = close + 1 else buf = buf .. ch j = j + 1 end end tokens[#tokens + 1] = buf i = j end end return tokens end
-- returns a query table, or nil and a message local function parseQuery(arg) local q = { words = {}, spells = {}, flags = {}, nums = {}, raw = arg } for _, tok in ipairs(splitWords(arg)) do local k, v = tok:match("^(%a+):(.+)$") local key = k and QKEY[k] if k and not key then return nil, "unknown search key '" .. k .. ":' (type, wear, spell, lvl, flag, in, name)" end if not key then q.words[#q.words + 1] = tok elseif key == "name" then q.words[#q.words + 1] = v elseif key == "spell" then q.spells[#q.spells + 1] = v elseif key == "flag" then q.flags[#q.flags + 1] = v elseif key == "in" then q.where = v elseif key == "type" then q.types = q.types or {} local t = typeMatches(v) if not t then return nil, "no item type matches '" .. v .. "'" end for n in pairs(t) do q.types[n] = true end elseif key == "wear" then local w = SLOT_ALIAS[v] or v if not oneOf(SLOTS, w, nil) or w == "any" then return nil, "no wear slot '" .. v .. "' (" .. table.concat(SLOTS, ", ") .. ")" end q.wear = w elseif key == "lvl" then local a, b = v:match("^(%d+)%-(%d+)$") if a then q.nums[#q.nums + 1] = tonumber(a) q.nums[#q.nums + 1] = tonumber(b) elseif v:match("^%d+%+$") then q.lvmin = tonumber(v:match("%d+")) elseif v:match("^<=?%d+$") then q.lvmax = tonumber(v:match("%d+")) elseif v:match("^>=?%d+$") then q.lvmin = tonumber(v:match("%d+")) elseif v:match("^%d+$") then q.nums[#q.nums + 1] = tonumber(v) else return nil, "level looks like lvl:10, lvl:1-10, lvl:10+ or lvl:<=10" end end end if #q.nums == 1 then q.lvmin, q.lvmax = q.nums[1], q.nums[1] elseif #q.nums >= 2 then table.sort(q.nums) q.lvmin, q.lvmax = q.nums[1], q.nums[#q.nums] end if q.where then local w = q.where q.scope = (w == "inv" or w == "inventory" or w == "carried") and -1 or (w == "worn" and -3) or (w == "keyring" and -2) or nil if not q.scope then q.bagText = w end end return q end
local function queryMatches(q, it) local lv = it.level or 0 if q.lvmin and lv < q.lvmin then return false end if q.lvmax and lv > q.lvmax then return false end if q.types and not q.types[it.type] then return false end if q.wear and slotOf(it) ~= q.wear then return false end for _, w in ipairs(q.words) do if not it.lname:find(w, 1, true) then return false end end if #q.spells > 0 or #q.flags > 0 then local r = itemRow(it) local sp = r and r.spells and tostring(r.spells):lower() or "" for _, w in ipairs(q.spells) do if not sp:find(w, 1, true) then return false end end local fl = r and r.flags and (", " .. tostring(r.flags):lower()) or "" for _, w in ipairs(q.flags) do local L = FLAG_LETTER[w] or (#w == 1 and w:upper()) if not (fl:find(w, 1, true) or (L and (it.flags or ""):find(L, 1, true))) then return false end end end return true end
local function matches(it) if view.q and not queryMatches(view.q, it) then return false end if view.group == "gear" and view.slot ~= "any" and slotOf(it) ~= view.slot then return false end if view.filter ~= "" and not it.lname:find(view.filter, 1, true) then return false end if view.group ~= "any" and groupOf(it) ~= view.group then return false end return true end
local function sortStacks(stacks) local s = view.sort table.sort(stacks, function(a, b) if s == "name" then if a.lname ~= b.lname then return a.lname < b.lname end elseif s == "type" then if a.type ~= b.type then return a.type < b.type end if a.level ~= b.level then return a.level > b.level end else if a.level ~= b.level then return a.level > b.level end end if a.lname ~= b.lname then return a.lname < b.lname end return a.ids[1] < b.ids[1] end) return stacks end
local function currentRows() local rows = {} if view.tab == "worn" then for slot = 0, WEAR_MAX do local it = worn[slot] if it and matches(it) then rows[#rows + 1] = { slot = slot, it = it } elseif not it and view.empty and view.filter == "" and not view.q and view.group == "any" and slot ~= 31 and slot ~= 32 then rows[#rows + 1] = { slot = slot } end end return rows end
local list = {} if view.tab == "inv" or view.tab == "all" then for _, it in pairs(inv) do it.loc = -1 if matches(it) then list[#list + 1] = it end end end if view.tab == "bags" and view.bag and bags[view.bag] then for _, it in pairs(bags[view.bag].items) do it.loc = view.bag if matches(it) then list[#list + 1] = it end end elseif view.tab == "all" then for bagId, b in pairs(bags) do if inv[bagId] then -- only bags we are really carrying for _, it in pairs(b.items) do it.loc = bagId if matches(it) then list[#list + 1] = it end end end end end if view.tab == "keyring" or view.tab == "all" then for _, it in ipairs(keyring) do it.loc = -2 if matches(it) then list[#list + 1] = it end end end if view.tab == "all" then -- "Everywhere" includes what you wear for slot = 0, WEAR_MAX do local it = worn[slot] if it then it.loc = -3 if matches(it) then list[#list + 1] = it end end end local q = view.q or {} local keep = {} for _, it in ipairs(list) do local ok = true if q.scope and it.loc ~= q.scope then ok = false end if q.bagText then if not (it.loc >= 0 and bagLabel(it.loc):lower():find(q.bagText, 1, true)) then ok = false end end if ok then keep[#keep + 1] = it end end list = keep end table.sort(list, function(a, b) -- the order the game listed them in local pa, pb = a.place or 0, b.place or 0 if pa ~= pb then return pa < pb end return tostring(a.id) < tostring(b.id) end) local stacks = sortStacks(stackItems(list)) -- an opened stack is followed by its individual items, in the order the game listed them local out = {} for _, st in ipairs(stacks) do out[#out + 1] = st if st.count > 1 and view.open[st.key] then st.expanded = true for k, id in ipairs(st.ids) do out[#out + 1] = { sub = true, parentKey = st.key, ordinal = k, ids = { id }, count = 1, name = st.name, runs = st.runs, lname = st.lname, level = st.level, flags = st.flags, type = st.type, unique = st.unique, timer = st.timer, loc = st.loc, place = st.place } end end end return out end

local curWin = WIN -- which window the drawing helpers write to (the identify card borrows them) local function textW(font, s) return WindowTextWidth(curWin, font, s) end local function text(font, s, x, y, col) return WindowText(curWin, font, s, x, y, 0, 0, col, false) end local function fillRect(x1, y1, x2, y2, col) WindowRectOp(curWin, 2, x1, y1, x2, y2, col) end
local function fit(font, s, maxw) if maxw <= 0 then return "" end if textW(font, s) <= maxw then return s end while #s > 1 and textW(font, s .. "..") > maxw do s = s:sub(1, -2) end return s .. ".." end
local function chip(P, x, y, label, fg, bg, id, store) local w = textW(FONT, label) + 12 fillRect(x, y, x + w, y + lh + 4, bg) text(FONT, label, x + 6, y + 2, fg) if store and id then store[#store + 1] = { id = id, x1 = x, x2 = x + w, y1 = y, y2 = y + lh + 4 } end return x + w end
local function hotspot(id, x1, y1, x2, y2, mouseup, tip, mousedown) if WindowMoveHotspot(WIN, id, x1, y1, x2, y2) ~= 0 then WindowAddHotspot(WIN, id, x1, y1, x2, y2, "", "", mousedown or "", "", mouseup or "", tip or "", 1, 0) added[id] = true return true end return false end
local function dropHotspot(id) if added[id] then WindowDeleteHotspot(WIN, id) added[id] = nil end end
local function setupFonts() WindowFont(WIN, FONT, fontName, fontHeight, false) WindowFont(WIN, FONT_B, fontName, fontHeight, true) lh = WindowFontInfo(WIN, FONT, 1) + 1 end
local function drawFlags(P, x, y, flags) for ch in flags:gmatch("%a") do local col = FLAG_COLOUR[ch] or ACC.grey fillRect(x, y + 1, x + lh - 3, y + lh + 1, mixC(P.panel, col, 0.38)) text(FONT, ch, x + 3, y + 1, mixC(col, P.text, 0.35)) x = x + lh - 1 end return x end
local function flagsWidth(flags) local _, n = flags:gsub("%a", "") return n * (lh - 1) end
-- an item name in the colours the game gave it, cut short with ".." if it would not fit local function drawRuns(P, runs, x, y, maxw) for _, r in ipairs(runs) do if maxw <= 0 then return end local t = r.text local w = textW(FONT, t) local col = r.col and legible(r.col, P) or P.text if w > maxw then text(FONT, fit(FONT, t, maxw), x, y, col) return end text(FONT, t, x, y, col) x, maxw = x + w, maxw - w end end
-- Every row uses the same columns so things line up from row to row: -- | count | name ..................... | where | flags | U | (level) | -- The widths are worked out from the rows being shown (see computeColumns). local COL = { countW = 0, flagsW = 0, uW = 0, levelW = 0, locW = 0, typeW = 0 } local bagLabels = {} -- [bag id] = label, refreshed at the start of every draw
local function locLabel(s) local full = s.loc == -2 and "keyring" or s.loc == -3 and "worn" or (bagLabels[s.loc] or ("bag " .. s.loc)) local num = full:match("#(%d+)$") return fit(FONT, num and ("bag #" .. num) or full, 120) end
local function computeColumns(rows) local maxCount, maxFlags, anyU, maxLv, locW, typeW = 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 0 for _, r in ipairs(rows) do local it if r.slot ~= nil then it = r.it else it = r end -- an empty worn slot has no item at all if it then if r.count and r.count > maxCount then maxCount = r.count end local _, nf = (it.flags or ""):gsub("%a", "") if nf > maxFlags then maxFlags = nf end if it.unique then anyU = true end local lw = textW(FONT, "(" .. (it.level or 0) .. ")") if lw > maxLv then maxLv = lw end local tw = textW(FONT, TYPE_NAME[it.type] or "?") if tw > typeW then typeW = tw end if r.slot == nil and r.loc and r.loc ~= -1 and view.tab == "all" then local w = textW(FONT, locLabel(r)) if w > locW then locW = w end end end end COL.countW = maxCount > 1 and (textW(FONT_B, "x" .. maxCount) + 10) or 0 COL.flagsW = maxFlags * (lh - 1) COL.uW = anyU and 20 or 0 COL.levelW = maxLv COL.locW = locW COL.typeW = math.min(typeW, 110) end
-- the right-hand columns, shared by item rows and worn rows; returns where the name has to stop local function drawRightColumns(P, x, y, w, it, loc, count) local rowH = lh + 4 local right = x + w - 6 local lv = "(" .. it.level .. ")" text(FONT, lv, right - textW(FONT, lv), y + 2, P.muted) -- level, right-aligned right = right - COL.levelW - 8 if COL.uW > 0 then if it.unique then fillRect(right - COL.uW + 4, y + 3, right - COL.uW + 16, y + rowH - 4, mixC(P.panel, ACC.purple, 0.45)) text(FONT, "U", right - COL.uW + 6, y + 2, ACC.purple) end right = right - COL.uW end if COL.flagsW > 0 then if it.flags ~= "" then drawFlags(P, right - COL.flagsW, y + 1, it.flags) end -- flags start at the same x right = right - COL.flagsW - 8 end if COL.typeW > 0 then local tn = fit(FONT, TYPE_NAME[it.type] or "?", COL.typeW) text(FONT, tn, right - COL.typeW, y + 2, mixC(TYPE_COLOUR[groupOf(it)], P.text, 0.25)) right = right - COL.typeW - 8 end if COL.locW > 0 then if loc and loc ~= -1 then text(FONT, locLabel({ loc = loc }), right - COL.locW, y + 2, ACC.teal) end right = right - COL.locW - 8 end return right end
local function drawStackRow(P, s, x, y, w) local rowH = lh + 4 fillRect(x, y, x + w, y + rowH - 1, P.panel) fillRect(x, y, x + 3, y + rowH - 1, TYPE_COLOUR[groupOf(s)]) local cx = x + 9 if COL.countW > 0 then if s.count > 1 then text(FONT_B, "x" .. s.count, cx, y + 2, ACC.gold) end cx = cx + COL.countW end local right = drawRightColumns(P, x, y, w, s, view.tab == "all" and s.loc or nil, s.count) -- a stack can be opened: "[+]" closed, "[-]" open; its individual items are indented with their serial local tag if s.sub then fillRect(x + 4, y, x + 6, y + rowH - 1, P.muted) cx = cx + 14 tag = "#" .. s.ordinal .. local function drawSlotRow(P, r, x, y, w) local rowH = lh + 4 fillRect(x, y, x + w, y + rowH - 1, P.panel) local lab = WEAR_NAME[r.slot] or ("slot " .. r.slot) local labW = textW(FONT, "Right finger") + 14 text(FONT, lab, x + 9, y + 2, P.muted) if not r.it then text(FONT, "empty", x + 9 + labW, y + 2, mixC(P.muted, P.panel, 0.4)) return end local it = r.it fillRect(x, y, x + 3, y + rowH - 1, TYPE_COLOUR[groupOf(it)]) local right = drawRightColumns(P, x, y, w, it, nil, 1) drawRuns(P, it.runs, x + 9 + labW, y + 2, right - (x + 9 + labW)) end

local function roomNumber() return tonumber(gmcp("room.info.num")) end
-- nil when the chosen way can be used from where you stand, else what is in the way identifyBlocked = function() if idMethod == "room" then local n = roomNumber() if n ~= IDENTIFY_ROOM then return "identifying without a wish or spell works only in room " .. IDENTIFY_ROOM .. " (you are in " .. tostring(n or "?") .. ")" end elseif idMethod == "lore" then local terrain = tostring(gmcp("room.info.terrain") or ""):lower() local where = (tostring(gmcp("room.info.name") or "") .. " " .. tostring(gmcp("room.info.details") or "")):lower() if not (terrain:find("city", 1, true) or where:find("donation", 1, true)) then return "lore works only in a donation room or in a city area (terrain here: " .. (terrain ~= "" and terrain or "unknown") .. ")" end end return nil end
local function identifyCommand(id, isWorn) local tail = tostring(id) .. (isWorn and " worn" or "") -- an item you wear is named "<serial> worn" if idMethod == "lore" then return "lore " .. tail end local spell = idMethod:match("^cast (.+)$") if spell then return "cast '" .. spell .. function IW_identify(id, isWorn) local why = identifyBlocked() if why then ColourNote("orange", "", "InventoryWindow: " .. why .. ". (invwin identify)") return false end idArmed = os.clock() Send(identifyCommand(id, isWorn)) return true end
setIdentifyMethod = function(arg) arg = trim(arg or "") local m if arg == "wish" or arg == "id" or arg == "identify" then m = "wish" elseif arg == "room" then m = "room" elseif arg == "lore" then m = "lore" else local spell = arg:match("^cast%s+(.+)$") if spell then m = "cast " .. spell:gsub("^[\'\"]", ""):gsub("[\'\"]$", "") end end if not m then ColourNote("cyan", "", "Identify method: " .. idMethod) ColourNote("silver", "", " invwin identify wish - the identify wish / id command (default)") ColourNote("silver", "", " invwin identify cast 'object read' - cast a spell on the item (any spell name)") ColourNote("silver", "", " invwin identify lore - the lore skill (donation rooms and city areas only)") ColourNote("silver", "", " invwin identify room - no wish or spell: works only in room " .. IDENTIFY_ROOM) return end idMethod = m SetVariable("idmethod", m) ColourNote("cyan", "", "InventoryWindow: items will be identified with: " .. m) end
-- only an identify you typed yourself (or asked for from the window) opens the card, not the ones other -- plugins send local typedInv = "i" function OnPluginCommandEntered(text_) -- MUSHclient checks every plugin's aliases separately, so another plugin with an "i" alias -- (aard_inventory_serials) would ask the game for the list a second time. This hook runs before -- any alias is matched: turn the typed "i" into our own command, which only this plugin answers. if takeI then local word, serialsWord = text_:match("^%s*([iI][nNvVeEtToOrRyY]*)%s*(%a*)%s*$") if word and ("inventory"):find(word:lower(), 1, true) == 1 then if serialsWord == "" then typedInv = text_ return "invwin printinv" elseif (serialsWord:lower() == "serial" or serialsWord:lower() == "serials") and not serialsPluginOn() then typedInv, serialsOnce = text_, true -- no serials plugin: answer "i serials" ourselves return "invwin printinv" end end end if text_:match("^%s*id%s+%S") or text_:match("^%s*identify%s+%S") or text_:match("^%s*lore%s+%S") or text_:match("^%s*c[a-z]*%s+['\"][^'\"]*read['\"]") then idArmed = os.clock() end return text_ end
-- Reads | Label : value | boxes, where one line can hold several pairs and a line starting with ":" -- carries on from the one above. Unknown labels are kept, so a weapon, potion or portal works too. local function parseIdentify(lines) local m = { fields = {}, by = {}, notes = {} } local sect = 0 for _, ln in ipairs(lines) do if ln:match("^%+") then sect = sect + 1 end if not ln:match("^%+") then local c = (ln:gsub("^|", ""):gsub("|%s*$", "")) c = (c:gsub("%s+$", "")) if c:match("^%s*:") then local extra = (c:gsub("^%s*:%s*", "")) local last = m.fields[#m.fields] if extra ~= "" then -- keywords and flags run on over several lines; anything else is a note ("Items inside weigh...") local lab = last and last.label:lower() or "" if last and (lab == "keywords" or lab == "flags" or last.value:match(",$")) then last.value = last.value .. " " .. extra else m.notes[#m.notes + 1] = extra end end else c = (c:gsub("%s+:", ":")) c = (c:gsub(":%s+", ": ")) for cell in (c .. " "):gmatch("(.-)%s%s+") do cell = trim(cell) if cell ~= "" then local label, value = cell:match("^([^:]-):%s*(.*)$") if label and label ~= "" then local f = { label = label, value = value, sect = sect } m.fields[#m.fields + 1] = f m.by[label:lower()] = f elseif #m.fields > 0 then local last = m.fields[#m.fields] last.parts = last.parts or { last.value } -- keep the pieces too (enchants are one per line) last.parts[#last.parts + 1] = cell last.value = last.value .. " " .. cell end end end end end end return m end
local function idNumber(s) return tonumber((tostring(s or ""):gsub(",", ""):match("-?%d+"))) end
local function idSections(m) local sections, member = {}, {} for i, f in ipairs(m.fields) do if (f.label:lower():match("mods$") or f.label:lower():match("^enchants?$")) then local entries = {} local fl, fv = f.value:match("^(.-):%s*(.*)$") if f.parts and f.label:lower():match("^enchants?$") then for _, part in ipairs(f.parts) do if part ~= "" then entries[#entries + 1] = { label = part, value = "" } end end elseif fl and fl ~= "" then entries[1] = { label = fl, value = fv } elseif f.value ~= "" then -- a comma list: "Dexterity +30, Luck -5" for part in f.value:gmatch("[^,]+") do local pl, pv = trim(part):match("^(.-)%s+([%+%-]%d+)$") entries[#entries + 1] = { label = pl or trim(part), value = pv or "" } end end for j = i + 1, #m.fields do local g = m.fields[j] if g.sect ~= f.sect or g.label:lower():match("mods$") or g.label:lower():match("^enchants?$") then break end entries[#entries + 1] = { label = g.label, value = g.value } member[j] = true end sections[i] = { title = f.label, entries = entries, enchant = f.label:lower():match("^enchants?$") ~= nil } end end return sections, member end
-- dry = true measures without drawing; returns the height used local function idBuild(P, W, x0, y0, dry) local m = idModel local y = y0 local function T(font, s, x, yy, col) if not dry then text(font, s, x, yy, col) end end local function F(x1, y1, x2, y2, col) if not dry then fillRect(x1, y1, x2, y2, col) end end
local function chips(list, accentOf) local x = x0 for _, c in ipairs(list) do local w = textW(FONT, c.text) + 12 if x + w > x0 + W and x > x0 then x, y = x0, y + lh + 8 end local acc = c.acc or accentOf and accentOf(c.text) or ACC.grey F(x, y, x + w, y + lh + 4, mixC(P.panel, acc, 0.30)) T(FONT, c.text, x + 6, y + 2, mixC(acc, P.text, 0.45)) x = x + w + 4 end y = y + lh + 10 end
local function field(label) return m.by[label] and m.by[label].value or nil end
-- title and keywords local name = field("name") or field("keywords") or "item" local _, nameRuns = parseColours(name) T(FONT_B, fit(FONT_B, (parseColours(name)), W), x0, y, P.text) y = y + lh + 3 if field("keywords") then T(FONT, fit(FONT, field("keywords"), W), x0, y, P.muted) y = y + lh + 6 end
-- the headline numbers local heads = {} if field("type") then heads[#heads + 1] = { text = field("type"), acc = ACC.teal } end if field("level") then heads[#heads + 1] = { text = "Level " .. field("level"), acc = ACC.blue } end if field("worth") then heads[#heads + 1] = { text = "Worth " .. field("worth"), acc = ACC.gold } end if field("weight") then heads[#heads + 1] = { text = "Weight " .. field("weight"), acc = ACC.grey } end if field("score") and idNumber(field("score")) ~= 0 then heads[#heads + 1] = { text = "Score " .. field("score"), acc = ACC.purple } end if #heads > 0 then chips(heads) end
-- flags, one chip each if field("flags") then local fl = {} for word in field("flags"):gmatch("[^,]+") do fl[#fl + 1] = { text = trim(word) } end chips(fl) -- plain chips: the game gives no meaning to flags, so none is invented end
-- everything else, as label and value (modifier lists become + / - chips) local used = { name = true, keywords = true, type = true, level = true, worth = true, weight = true, score = true, flags = true, id = true, capacity = true, holding = true, ["heaviest item"] = true, ["items inside"] = true, ["tot weight"] = true, ["item burden"] = true } -- "Stat Mods" and "Resist Mods" are headings: every stat after one (in the same box section) belongs to it, -- including the first, which the game prints on the heading's own line local sections, member = idSections(m) local labW = 0 for i, f in ipairs(m.fields) do if not used[f.label:lower()] and not sections[i] and not member[i] then labW = math.max(labW, textW(FONT, f.label)) end end labW = labW + 14 for i, f in ipairs(m.fields) do if sections[i] then local sec = sections[i] y = y + 4 local tw = textW(FONT_B, sec.title) + 12 F(x0, y - 1, x0 + tw, y + lh + 3, mixC(P.panel, ACC.teal, 0.35)) T(FONT_B, sec.title, x0 + 6, y + 1, mixC(ACC.teal, P.text, 0.5)) y = y + lh + 7 -- two columns of "name value" (the way the game lays them out) only when every entry fits in half the -- width; otherwise one entry per line, and a line that is still too long wraps under itself local inner = W - 12 local need = 0 for _, e in ipairs(sec.entries) do need = math.max(need, textW(FONT, e.label) + (e.value ~= "" and (textW(FONT, e.value) + 24) or 0)) end local cols = (not sec.enchant and need * 2 + 12 <= inner) and 2 or 1 local colW = math.floor(inner / cols) for k, e in ipairs(sec.entries) do local cx = x0 + 12 + ((k - 1) % cols) * colW local vcol = e.value:find("^%-") and ACC.red or (e.value:find("^%+") and ACC.green or P.text) if sec.enchant and e.value ~= "" then -- an enchant: its name, then what it does, lined up like the game's own box local nw = 0 for _, o in ipairs(sec.entries) do if o.value ~= "" then nw = math.max(nw, textW(FONT, o.label)) end end T(FONT, e.label, cx, y, P.text) T(FONT, fit(FONT, e.value, W - 12 - nw - 14), cx + nw + 14, y, P.text) y = y + lh + 3 elseif e.value ~= "" then T(FONT, fit(FONT, e.label, colW - textW(FONT, e.value) - 20), cx, y, P.text) T(FONT, e.value, cx + colW - 12 - textW(FONT, e.value), y, mixC(vcol, P.text, vcol == P.text and 0 or 0.25)) if k % cols == 0 or k == #sec.entries then y = y + lh + 3 end else -- free text (an enchant): wrap by words inside the width local line, first = "", true local function flush() T(FONT, line, cx + (first and 0 or 12), y, P.text) y = y + lh + 3 first = false end for word in e.label:gmatch("%S+") do local try = (line == "") and word or (line .. " " .. word) if line ~= "" and textW(FONT, try) > (inner - (first and 0 or 12)) then flush() line = word else line = try end end if line ~= "" then flush() end end end y = y + 3 elseif not used[f.label:lower()] and not member[i] and f.value ~= "" then T(FONT, f.label, x0, y, P.muted) T(FONT, fit(FONT, f.value, W - labW), x0 + labW, y, P.text) y = y + lh + 3 end end
-- containers: how full, and the rest of the numbers local cap, hold = idNumber(field("capacity")), idNumber(field("holding")) if cap and hold and cap > 0 then y = y + 6 local frac = math.max(0, math.min(1, hold / cap)) local bw = W - 130 F(x0, y + 3, x0 + bw, y + lh - 3, P.track) F(x0, y + 3, x0 + math.floor(bw * frac), y + lh - 3, frac > 0.9 and ACC.red or (frac > 0.75 and ACC.amber or ACC.green)) T(FONT, string.format("%s / %s", commas(hold), commas(cap)), x0 + bw + 8, y, P.text) y = y + lh + 6 local cw = 0 for _, lab in ipairs({ "items inside", "heaviest item", "tot weight", "item burden" }) do if field(lab) then cw = math.max(cw, textW(FONT, m.by[lab].label)) end end cw = cw + 14 for _, lab in ipairs({ "items inside", "heaviest item", "tot weight", "item burden" }) do if field(lab) then T(FONT, m.by[lab].label, x0, y, P.muted) T(FONT, field(lab), x0 + cw, y, P.text) y = y + lh + 3 end end end for _, n in ipairs(m.notes) do T(FONT, fit(FONT, n, W), x0, y, P.muted) y = y + lh + 3 end return y - y0 end

-- the width (inside the card's margins) the content wants: the longest enchant line, or two columns of mods local function idWidthWanted(m) local sections = idSections(m) local enchant, mods = 0, 0 for _, sec in pairs(sections) do local nameW, valW, text = 0, 0, 0 for _, e in ipairs(sec.entries) do if sec.enchant and e.value ~= "" then nameW = math.max(nameW, textW(FONT, e.label)) valW = math.max(valW, textW(FONT, e.value)) elseif e.value ~= "" then nameW = math.max(nameW, textW(FONT, e.label)) valW = math.max(valW, textW(FONT, e.value)) else text = math.max(text, textW(FONT, e.label)) end end enchant = math.max(enchant, text + 12) if sec.enchant then enchant = math.max(enchant, 12 + nameW + 14 + valW) elseif nameW > 0 then mods = math.max(mods, 2 * (nameW + valW + 24) + 12) end end return math.max(enchant, mods) end
local function idShow() idEnsureWindow() curWin = IDWIN WindowFont(IDWIN, FONT, fontName, fontHeight, false) WindowFont(IDWIN, FONT_B, fontName, fontHeight, true) lh = WindowFontInfo(IDWIN, FONT, 1) + 1 local P = palette() -- size the card to its content (never narrower than 320, never wider than the screen allows) local wantW = idWidthWanted(idModel) + 2 * PAD + 6 local maxW = math.max(320, (tonumber(GetInfo(281)) or 1000) - 60) local newW = math.max(320, math.min(wantW, maxW)) if newW ~= idWin.width then idWin:resize(newW, idWin.height) end local W = idWin.width - 2 * PAD - 6 local need = idBuild(P, W, 0, 0, true) + (idWin.bodytop or 24) + 22 curWin = WIN local H = math.max(120, math.min(need, math.max(200, GetInfo(280) - 100))) idWin:resize(idWin.width, H) idShown = true idWin:show() pcall(function() idWin:bring_to_front() end) end
